authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed protocol specifications, cryptographic commitments, pinned implementation source, and exact test vectors.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and protocol/security specifications with explicit threat-model and interoperability criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Formal state-machine fixtures, cross-implementation vectors, adversarial protocol tests, and independent security review.
authority.deployment_authority: No production communications authority; pre-alpha implementations and demos remain explicitly non-production.

data.retention: Specifications, threat models, vectors, failed attacks, implementation identities, and review evidence remain version controlled.
data.deletion: Compromised implementations, algorithms, or vectors are deprecated or revoked with retained disclosure and supersession evidence.
data.secret_storage: Private keys, live message material, and deployment credentials never belong in the repository or test fixtures.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Protocol versions, keys, implementations, and public claims are versioned and independently revocable or deprecated.

stabilization.summary: Specify protocol states and transitions as executable fixtures with invariant, liveness, and invalid-transition checks.
Publish exact Python/Rust vectors covering commitments, relay behavior, replay, forks, malformed data, and error states.
Add adversarial metadata-leakage and transport tests and obtain independent review before strengthening privacy claims.
